sections.A: Manipulation (grade V) range ke aakhir mein tez aur chhota thrust hai.
sections.B: Kuch reedh aur doosre joints ke maslon mein thori der ka dard ka aaraam aur behtar movement ke liye.
sections.C: Serious nuqsan kam hote hain lekin gardan ki manipulation mein sab se zyada fikr hai. Screening aur patient ki marzi zaroori hai.
sections.D: Aam techniques: thoracic supine thrust, lumbar side-lying rotation waghaira.
sections.E: Manipulation tab karein jab saaf mechanical masla ho, koi contraindication na ho aur patient raazi ho.
sections.F: Sawaal hal karein. 'Pop' ki aawaz zaroori nahi; gardan dard mein aksar thoracic manipulation behtar aur mehfooz hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
